execute a plan: The team spent months preparing and finally executed a plan to rescue the trapped miners.
團隊花了好幾個月準備，終於執行了救出受困礦工的計畫。
execute an order: The soldiers were trained to execute an order immediately without asking any questions.
士兵們受過訓練，會立即執行命令而不提出任何疑問。
execute a prisoner: Many countries no longer execute a prisoner, even one who has committed terrible crimes.
許多國家已不再處決犯人，即使是犯下可怕罪行的人也一樣。
execute a program: When you click this icon, the computer will execute a program that checks your files for viruses.
當你點擊這個圖示時，電腦就會執行一個檢查檔案是否有病毒的程式。
execute a contract: Both companies must sign and execute a contract before work on the new building can begin.
兩家公司必須簽署並履行合約，新大樓的工程才能開始。
exercise one's rights: Every adult citizen should exercise their rights by voting in elections and speaking up about important issues.
每位成年公民都應該藉由在選舉中投票、對重要議題發聲來行使自己的權利。
exercise control: Parents should exercise control over how much time young children spend online every day.
父母應該控制幼童每天上網的時間。
exercise influence: Popular singers can exercise influence over what their young fans wear and buy.
受歡迎的歌手能對年輕歌迷的穿著和購買產生影響力。
exercise judgment: Drivers must exercise judgment when the road is icy and slow down before turning.
路面結冰時，駕駛人必須運用判斷力，在轉彎前減速。
exercise power: A good leader should exercise power fairly and listen carefully to the people.
一位好的領導者應該公平地行使權力，並仔細傾聽人民的聲音。
exhaust the supply: So many people bought bottled water before the typhoon that they exhausted the supply in every store.
颱風來臨前有太多人買瓶裝水，以至於每家店的存貨都被買光了。
exhaust all options: We should exhaust all options before deciding to close the small family shop for good.
在決定永久關閉這家家庭小店之前，我們應該用盡所有選擇。
be exhausted: After running the marathon, she was exhausted and fell asleep as soon as she got home.
跑完馬拉松後，她筋疲力盡，一回到家就睡著了。
exhaust a topic: The professor talked for three hours and seemed to exhaust a topic completely, so nobody had any questions left.
教授講了三個小時，似乎把這個話題完全講透了，所以沒有人再有任何問題。
exhibit symptoms: Patients who exhibit symptoms such as fever and coughing should stay at home and see a doctor.
出現發燒和咳嗽等症狀的病人應該待在家裡並看醫生。
exhibit courage: The young firefighter exhibited courage when he ran into the burning house to save a child.
那位年輕的消防員衝進失火的房子救出一個孩子，展現了勇氣。
exhibit paintings: The gallery will exhibit paintings by local artists throughout the summer, and entry is free.
這間畫廊整個夏天都會展出本地藝術家的畫作，而且免費入場。
exhibit signs of stress: Students often exhibit signs of stress, such as headaches and poor sleep, before big exams.
學生在大考前常會出現壓力的跡象，例如頭痛和睡不好。
expand the business: The owner wants to expand the business by opening two more shops in the city next year.
老闆想在明年於市區再開兩家店來擴展事業。
expand one's horizons: Traveling to other countries can expand your horizons and teach you about different cultures.
到其他國家旅行能開拓你的視野，讓你認識不同的文化。
expand on a point: The teacher asked me to expand on a point I had made by giving a few more examples.
老師要我多舉幾個例子，來詳細說明我提出的一個論點。
the universe expands: Scientists have found that as the universe expands, galaxies move farther away from one another.
科學家發現，隨著宇宙擴張，星系彼此之間的距離越來越遠。
expand into new markets: The Taiwanese tea company hopes to expand into new markets in Europe and America next year.
這家台灣茶葉公司希望明年拓展到歐美的新市場。
experiment with new ideas: Good chefs often experiment with new ideas, mixing flavors that nobody has tried before.
優秀的廚師常會嘗試新點子，混合別人從未試過的口味。
experiment on animals: Many people believe companies should not experiment on animals just to test makeup products.
許多人認為公司不應該只為了測試化妝品就拿動物做實驗。
experiment with drugs: Some teenagers experiment with drugs because of pressure from friends, which can seriously harm their health.
有些青少年因為朋友的壓力而嘗試毒品，這可能嚴重傷害他們的健康。
the population exploded: After the factory opened, the population exploded, and the quiet village quickly became a busy town.
工廠開設後，人口暴增，這個寧靜的村莊很快變成了熱鬧的城鎮。
explode with anger: When he found his new car badly scratched, he would explode with anger and shout at everyone nearby.
當他發現新車被刮得很嚴重時，他會勃然大怒，對附近的每個人大吼。
explode a myth: This science video helps explode a myth that people only use ten percent of their brains.
這支科學影片有助於破除「人們只用了百分之十的大腦」這個迷思。
explode into laughter: The joke was so funny that the whole class seemed to explode into laughter at the same moment.
那個笑話太好笑了，全班似乎在同一刻爆笑出來。
sales exploded: After a famous singer posted a photo with the drink, sales exploded and stores quickly ran out of it.
一位知名歌手貼出和這款飲料的合照後，銷量暴增，商店很快就賣光了。
